declared.fault_injection: scripts/robustness_fault_proxy.py (test-only proxy; the native worker binary and the registry are unchanged)
declared.trial_count_source: declared here; the Master plan states crash containment 100% without a trial count

timing_policy.gating: none on wall-clock or RSS comparisons; only hard declared limits gate (peak worker RSS below the memory ceiling, wall time below the wall limit)
timing_policy.memory_scope: peak RSS of every compute and validator worker process of the job (Windows GetProcessMemoryInfo; Linux VmHWM sampled from /proc about every millisecond, a lower bound of the true peak); excludes the Python host and parsers
timing_policy.wall_clock_tolerance: informational; reruns on the same machine are expected within a factor of 3 of the recorded value, a slower machine may exceed it

speed.note: informational; never gated (includes validator time; cache hits still run every mandatory validator live)
